cn-tabs-trigger: judged CORRECTION - default-variant data-active:shadow-sm dropped (see lyra ledger twin; settled-read receipt, only vega ships it upstream).
cn-input-otp-slot: judged CORRECTION - not-first:ml-1 added (upstream's cn-input-otp-group gap-1 has no poetry attachment point; per-slot underline segmentation is the control's primary structure under an underline theme)
cn-input-group-addon-align-inline-start/end: judged CORRECTION -> pl-0/pr-0 explicit flush. NEW DETECTOR TRAP: upstream sera COMMENTS these rules out (only style that does) but detector.rb parses commented rules as live - always check raw context for /* */ around a surprising diff
cn-command-input-wrapper: judged refinement - m-1 mb-0 added so the underline seats 4px off the panel edges like upstream's inner box; also the combobox search row (poetry mounts the command wrapper there - the combobox-content *:data-[slot=input-group] cluster is INERT in poetry DOM, roster-wide since W1, kept as upstream-verbatim documentation)
KNOWN-DELTA (roster-locked, no cn hook): select viewport p-1/scroll-my-1 is structural (select/style.rb) vs upstream sera's select-group p-1.5 - items inset 2px tighter; joins the calendar-cell class
KNOWN-DELTA (roster structural): drawer scrim is baked inline (drawer/style.rb black/10 blur-xs, swipe-modulated) in all nine themes - upstream sera wants black/20 blur-sm; W5 roster-pass candidate alongside the tabs active shadow
KNOWN-NUANCE (shared-wrapper tradeoff): the command wrapper serves both the palette and the combobox search row; its m-1 inset is exact for the palette (upstream wrapper p-1 = 4px) and 2px shy in the combobox embed (upstream group m-1.5 = 6px, h-8 row). Judged 2px-class residual; a context-scoped in-data-[slot=combobox-content] override is possible if it ever matters
KNOWN-NUANCE (ornament-grade, no ground truth): cn-input-otp-separator stays dropped (roster-wide since W1; poetry renders its own 16x2 dash, upstream would size a lucide minus at 14px ~ an 8px bar). No upstream OTP surface renders at d0fae528 (panels lack one; /view routes dead), so the delta is arithmetic-only. Revisit if an upstream OTP capture ever lands or the separator gains a poetry name
